profile.headline: Software Engineer | Data Analyst
profile.summary: A highly motivated professional engineer with a history of working in engineering, technology, and analytic fields. With experience in multiple coding and design programs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead and assisted project teams in implementation, testing, issue tracking, change order management, and trend analysis.
•	Used AutoCAD and Visio to create detailed layouts of equipment and conveyors.
•	Monitored production servers and automated processes using Vcenter and vendor software.

positions.title: Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Clean and organized unfiltered maintenance data to determine execution costs for specific repairs 
        of equipment 
•	Applied statistical tools like excel (V-lookup, pivot tables) and access to identify, analyze, and 
        interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets that could be helpful in finding solutions and 
        predictions.
•	Prepared final analysis reports for the stakeholders to understand the data-analysis steps, enabling 
        them to take important decisions based on various facts and trends.

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed 100+ removal and installation AutoCAD drawings for                piping and HVAC systems
•	Incorporated an innovative technology (3-D Laser Scanning) process to improve the RCOH of a US Navy ship surveying process.
•	Created 3D models using inventor of piping and HVAC systems
•	Created and implemented a quality assurance process for developing high quality drawings
•	Completed multiple HVAC calculation packages
•	Developed schedules, works scopes, and coordinated with shipyards, operations, and regulatory bodies to ensure the shipyard upgrades are executed safely and efficiently

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Applied C++, Python, augmented reality applications, and visual odometry applications. 
•	Implemented IMU, Lidar, and multiple sensors into the design of the VTOL aircraft
•	Installed Ubuntu and Raspberry Pi OS onto multiple raspberry pi’s 
•	Used bash shell scripting

positions.title: Quality/Administrator Specialist
positions.description:
•	Created databases to further help organize inventory
•	Completed administrative and quality assurance tasks
•	Completed robot maintenance.
•	Performed time studies to analyse the effort and time of worker’s task.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Helped create a makerspace by using card readers that was coded using python and designed a database to store information on the cards.
• Used a raspberry pi as an user interface to print to multiple 3d printers wirelessly.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration
